Local rzstd change: explicitly mask frame-magic bytes before uint8_t conversion, avoiding MSVC constant-truncation warnings without changing emitted bytes.
Local rzstd change: replace the volatile BMI2 dispatch flag and constructor with native retro_atomic acquire/release publication, including concurrent lazy initialization.
Local rzstd extension: reusable single-owner decoder scratch API; ZArchive retains one per reader to eliminate per-block scratch allocation/free without clearing the full decode workspace.
Local rzstd optimization: terminal matches use bounded 16-byte copies after safely growing short periods, retaining a narrow tail and exact output bounds.
